title: Murder
description: Culpable homicide is murder if the act by which the death is caused is done with the intention of causing death
penalty: Death or life imprisonment

title: Punishment for murder
description: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death, or imprisonment for life, and shall also be liable to fine
penalty: Death or life imprisonment and fine

title: Punishment for culpable homicide not amounting to murder
description: Whoever commits culpable homicide not amounting to murder shall be punished
penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years or life with fine

title: Causing death by negligence
description: Whoever causes death of any person by doing any rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide
penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Dowry death
description: Where the death of a woman is caused by burns or bodily injury or occurs within seven years of marriage under abnormal circumstances
penalty: Imprisonment minimum 7 years, may extend to life

title: Attempt to murder
description: Whoever does any act with such intention or knowledge and under such circumstances that if he by that act caused death
penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine, if hurt caused may extend to life

title: Hurt
description: Whoever causes bodily pain, disease or infirmity to any person is said to cause hurt
penalty: Imprisonment up to 1 year or fine up to 1000 or both

title: Grievous hurt
description: Eight kinds of hurt designated as grievous - emasculation, permanent privation of sight, hearing, etc.
penalty: Varies based on offense

title: Punishment for voluntarily causing hurt
description: Whoever voluntarily causes hurt shall be punished
penalty: Imprisonment up to 1 year or fine up to 1000 or both

title: Voluntarily causing hurt by dangerous weapons
description: Whoever voluntarily causes hurt by means of any instrument for shooting, stabbing, cutting
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Punishment for voluntarily causing grievous hurt
description: Whoever voluntarily causes grievous hurt shall be punished
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by dangerous weapons
description: Whoever voluntarily causes grievous hurt by dangerous weapons or means
penalty: Life imprisonment or imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Voluntarily causing grievous hurt by use of acid
description: Whoever causes permanent or partial damage or deformity to any person by throwing acid
penalty: Imprisonment minimum 10 years may extend to life and fine

title: Voluntarily throwing or attempting to throw acid
description: Whoever throws or attempts to throw acid on any person
penalty: Imprisonment minimum 5 years may extend to 7 years and fine

title: Assault or criminal force to woman with intent to outrage her modesty
description: Whoever assaults or uses criminal force to any woman intending to outrage her modesty
penalty: Imprisonment minimum 1 year may extend to 5 years and fine

title: Sexual harassment
description: Physical contact and advances, demand or request for sexual favors, showing pornography, making sexually colored remarks
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Assault or use of criminal force to woman with intent to disrobe
description: Whoever assaults or uses criminal force to any woman with intention to disrobe
penalty: Imprisonment minimum 3 years may extend to 7 years and fine

title: Voyeurism
description: Whoever watches or captures image of a woman in private act where she would have expectation of privacy
penalty: Imprisonment minimum 1 year may extend to 3 years and fine, subsequent conviction 3-7 years and fine

title: Stalking
description: Whoever follows or contacts a woman or monitors her use of internet despite clear indication of disinterest
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine, subsequent offense up to 5 years and fine

title: Punishment for kidnapping
description: Whoever kidnaps any person from India or from lawful guardianship
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Kidnapping or abducting to murder
description: Whoever kidnaps or abducts any person in order that such person may be murdered
penalty: Death or life imprisonment and fine

title: Kidnapping or abducting with intent to secretly confine
description: Whoever kidnaps or abducts any person with intent to cause secret or wrongful confinement
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Kidnapping, abducting or inducing woman to compel marriage
description: Whoever kidnaps or abducts any woman with intent that she may be compelled to marry
penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Procuration of minor girl
description: Whoever induces any minor girl under eighteen years to go from any place or to do any act
penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Kidnapping or abducting to subject person to slavery
description: Whoever kidnaps or abducts any person in order that such person may be subjected to slavery
penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Wrongfully concealing or keeping in confinement kidnapped person
description: Whoever wrongfully conceals or keeps in confinement any kidnapped or abducted person
penalty: Punishment as for kidnapping or abduction

title: Rape
description: A man is said to commit rape if he has sexual intercourse with a woman under circumstances falling under various descriptions
penalty: Rigorous imprisonment minimum 10 years may extend to life and fine

title: Punishment for rape
description: Whoever commits rape shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment
penalty: Minimum 10 years may extend to life imprisonment and fine

title: Punishment for causing death or resulting in persistent vegetative state of victim
description: Whoever committing rape causes death or persistent vegetative state
penalty: Rigorous imprisonment minimum 20 years may extend to life or death

title: Punishment for rape on woman under twelve years
description: Whoever commits rape on a woman under twelve years of age
penalty: Rigorous imprisonment minimum 20 years may extend to life or death and fine

title: Sexual intercourse by husband upon his wife during separation
description: Whoever has sexual intercourse with his wife who is living separately under decree of separation
penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years and fine

title: Sexual intercourse by person in authority
description: Whoever being in position of authority takes advantage and has sexual intercourse not amounting to rape
penalty: Rigorous imprisonment minimum 5 years may extend to 10 years and fine

title: Gang rape
description: Where a woman is raped by one or more persons constituting a group
penalty: Rigorous imprisonment minimum 20 years may extend to life and fine

title: Unnatural offences
description: Whoever voluntarily has carnal intercourse against the order of nature
penalty: Imprisonment for life or imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Theft
description: Whoever intending to take dishonestly any movable property out of possession without consent
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Punishment for theft
description: Whoever commits theft shall be punished
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Theft in dwelling house
description: Whoever commits theft in any building, tent or vessel used as a human dwelling
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Theft by clerk or servant of property in possession of master
description: Whoever being clerk or servant commits theft in respect of any property in possession of master
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Theft after preparation for causing death, hurt or restraint
description: Whoever commits theft having made preparation for causing death, hurt or wrongful restraint
penalty: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Extortion
description: Whoever intentionally puts any person in fear of injury and dishonestly induces the person to deliver any property
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Punishment for extortion
description: Whoever commits extortion shall be punished
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Putting person in fear of injury to commit extortion
description: Whoever puts or attempts to put any person in fear of injury to commit extortion
penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Extortion by putting a person in fear of death or grievous hurt
description: Whoever commits extortion by putting any person in fear of death or grievous hurt
penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Putting person in fear of death or grievous hurt to commit extortion
description: Whoever puts or attempts to put any person in fear of death or grievous hurt to commit extortion
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Punishment for robbery
description: Whoever commits robbery shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment
penalty: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Attempt to commit robbery
description: Whoever attempts to commit robbery shall be punished
penalty: Rigorous imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Punishment for dacoity
description: Whoever commits dacoity shall be punished with imprisonment for life or rigorous imprisonment
penalty: Life imprisonment or rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Dacoity with murder
description: If any one of five or more persons who are conjointly committing dacoity commits murder
penalty: Death or life imprisonment or rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Robbery or dacoity with attempt to cause death or grievous hurt
description: If at the time of robbery or dacoity the offender uses any deadly weapon
penalty: Rigorous imprisonment minimum 7 years

title: Making preparation to commit dacoity
description: Whoever makes any preparation for committing dacoity shall be punished
penalty: Rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Assembling for purpose of committing dacoity
description: Whoever is one of five or more persons assembled for the purpose of committing dacoity
penalty: Rigorous imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Criminal breach of trust
description: Whoever being in any manner entrusted with property dishonestly misappropriates or converts to own use
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Punishment for criminal breach of trust
description: Whoever commits criminal breach of trust shall be punished
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Criminal breach of trust by carrier
description: Whoever being a carrier, wharfinger or warehouse-keeper commits criminal breach of trust
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Criminal breach of trust by clerk or servant
description: Whoever being a clerk or servant commits criminal breach of trust
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Criminal breach of trust by public servant, banker, merchant, agent
description: Whoever being public servant, banker, merchant or agent commits criminal breach of trust
penalty: Life imprisonment or imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Cheating
description: Whoever by deceiving any person fraudulently or dishonestly induces the person to deliver any property
penalty: Imprisonment up to 1 year or fine or both

title: Cheating by personation
description: A person is said to cheat by personation if he cheats by pretending to be some other person
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Punishment for cheating
description: Whoever cheats shall be punished
penalty: Imprisonment up to 1 year or fine or both

title: Cheating with knowledge that wrongful loss may ensue
description: Whoever cheats with knowledge that wrongful loss may be thereby caused
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Punishment for cheating by personation
description: Whoever cheats by personation shall be punished
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property
description: Whoever cheats and thereby dishonestly induces the person deceived to deliver any property
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Mischief
description: Whoever with intent to cause wrongful loss or damage destroys any property or diminishes its value
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 months or fine or both

title: Punishment for mischief
description: Whoever commits mischief shall be punished
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 months or fine or both

title: Mischief causing damage to amount of fifty rupees
description: Whoever commits mischief and causes loss or damage to the amount of fifty rupees or upwards
penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Mischief by killing or maiming animal of value of ten rupees
description: Whoever commits mischief by killing, poisoning, maiming or rendering useless any animal
penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Mischief by killing or maiming cattle
description: Whoever commits mischief by killing, poisoning, maiming or rendering useless any elephant, camel, horse
penalty: Imprisonment up to 5 years or fine or both

title: Mischief by fire or explosive substance with intent to cause damage
description: Whoever commits mischief by fire or any explosive substance
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Mischief by fire or explosive substance with intent to destroy house
description: Whoever commits mischief by fire or explosive substance to any building used as a place for worship or human dwelling
penalty: Life imprisonment or imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Criminal trespass
description: Whoever enters into property in possession of another with intent to commit an offence
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 months or fine up to 500 or both

title: House-trespass
description: Whoever commits criminal trespass by entering into any building, tent or vessel used as a human dwelling
penalty: Imprisonment up to 1 year or fine up to 1000 or both

title: Punishment for criminal trespass
description: Whoever commits criminal trespass shall be punished
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 months or fine up to 500 or both

title: Punishment for house-trespass
description: Whoever commits house-trespass shall be punished
penalty: Imprisonment up to 1 year or fine up to 1000 or both

title: House-trespass to commit offence punishable with death
description: Whoever commits house-trespass in order to commit an offence punishable with death
penalty: Life imprisonment or rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: House-trespass to commit offence punishable with life imprisonment
description: Whoever commits house-trespass to commit an offence punishable with life imprisonment
penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: House-trespass to commit offence punishable with imprisonment
description: Whoever commits house-trespass in order to commit an offence punishable with imprisonment
penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years and fine

title: House-trespass after preparation for hurt, assault or wrongful restraint
description: Whoever commits house-trespass having made preparation for causing hurt
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Punishment for lurking house-trespass
description: Whoever commits lurking house-trespass or house-breaking shall be punished
penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years and fine

title: Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking to commit offence punishable with imprisonment
description: Whoever commits lurking house-trespass or house-breaking to commit an offence punishable with imprisonment
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine

title: Lurking house-trespass or house-breaking by night to commit offence punishable with imprisonment
description: Whoever commits lurking house-trespass by night or house-breaking by night to commit an offence
penalty: Imprisonment up to 5 years and fine

title: Grievous hurt caused whilst committing lurking house trespass or house-breaking
description: Whoever whilst committing lurking house-trespass or house-breaking causes grievous hurt
penalty: Life imprisonment or imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Death or grievous hurt caused by one of several persons jointly concerned in house-breaking
description: If at the time of committing house-breaking any person concerned causes death or grievous hurt
penalty: Life imprisonment or rigorous imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Forgery
description: Whoever makes any false document with intent to cause damage or injury to any person
penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Making a false document
description: A person is said to make a false document when he dishonestly or fraudulently makes a document
penalty: As per section 463

title: Punishment for forgery
description: Whoever commits forgery shall be punished
penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Forgery of valuable security, will
description: Whoever forges a document purporting to be a valuable security or will
penalty: Life imprisonment or imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Forgery for purpose of cheating
description: Whoever commits forgery intending that the document forged shall be used for the purpose of cheating
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Forgery for purpose of harming reputation
description: Whoever commits forgery intending that the forged document shall harm the reputation of any party
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine

title: Forged document
description: A false document made wholly or in part by forgery is designated a forged document
penalty: N/A

title: Using as genuine a forged document
description: Whoever fraudulently or dishonestly uses as genuine any document which he knows to be forged
penalty: Same as if he had forged such document

title: Having possession of document described as valuable security knowing it to be forged
description: Whoever has in his possession any forged document knowing it to be forged
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine if valuable security

title: Counterfeiting device or mark used for authenticating documents
description: Whoever counterfeits any device or mark used for authenticating any document
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Falsification of accounts
description: Whoever being clerk, officer or servant willfully and with intent to defraud destroys, alters or falsifies any book
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years or fine or both

title: Cohabitation caused by man deceitfully inducing belief of lawful marriage
description: Every man who by deceit causes any woman to believe she is lawfully married to him
penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Marrying again during lifetime of husband or wife
description: Whoever having a husband or wife living marries again in any case
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Same offence with concealment of former marriage
description: Whoever commits bigamy having concealed the former marriage from the person married
penalty: Imprisonment up to 10 years and fine

title: Marriage ceremony fraudulently gone through without lawful marriage
description: Whoever dishonestly or with fraudulent intention goes through ceremony of marriage knowing it is not lawful
penalty: Imprisonment up to 7 years and fine

title: Adultery
description: Whoever has sexual intercourse with a person who is and whom he knows to be the wife of another man
penalty: Struck down by Supreme Court in 2018

title: Enticing or taking away or detaining with criminal intent a married woman
description: Whoever takes or entices away any woman who is and whom he knows to be the wife of any other man
penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Husband or relative of husband subjecting woman to cruelty
description: Whoever being husband or relative of husband subjects woman to cruelty
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years and fine

title: Defamation
description: Whoever by words spoken or intended to be read makes any imputation concerning any person
penalty: Simple imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Punishment for defamation
description: Whoever defames another shall be punished
penalty: Simple imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Printing or engraving matter known to be defamatory
description: Whoever prints or engraves any matter knowing it to be defamatory
penalty: Simple imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Sale of printed or engraved substance containing defamatory matter
description: Whoever sells or offers for sale any printed or engraved substance containing defamatory matter
penalty: Simple imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Criminal intimidation
description: Whoever threatens another with injury to his person, reputation or property with intent to cause alarm
penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Intentional insult with intent to provoke breach of peace
description: Whoever intentionally insults and thereby gives provocation intending to cause breach of peace
penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both

title: Statements conducing to public mischief
description: Whoever makes statement or report with intent to cause mutiny, fear or alarm to public
penalty: Imprisonment up to 3 years or fine or both

title: Punishment for criminal intimidation
description: Whoever commits criminal intimidation shall be punished
penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years or fine or both, if threat is to cause death or grievous hurt up to 7 years

title: Criminal intimidation by anonymous communication
description: Whoever commits criminal intimidation by an anonymous communication
penalty: Imprisonment up to 2 years in addition to punishment under section 506

title: Word, gesture or act intended to insult modesty of a woman
description: Whoever intending to insult the modesty of any woman utters any word or makes gesture
penalty: Simple imprisonment up to 3 years and fine

title: Punishment for attempting to commit offences
description: Whoever attempts to commit an offence punishable by this Code with imprisonment
penalty: Imprisonment up to one-half of longest term provided for that offence
